dependencies.upstream_resolution_rule: ⚠️ EVERY upstream entry carries exactly one resolution: `slug` / `slugs` / `terminal`+`kind` / `unresolved`. TERMINAL means nothing is missing; UNRESOLVED means a report is owed. Never merged.
dependencies.edge_kind_rule: `backing` = my SOLVENCY depends on it. `venue` = my EXIT PRICE does.

EUROP/native ETH omissions explain most alleged Ethereum API overstatement. Cross-chain USDm bridge availability remains unverified; analyzer false flags are static. downstream_basis.asserted_only_note: None — every asserted edge is reproducible from an upstream array.
downstream_basis.do_not_hand_edit: ⚠️ downstream_tracked is GENERATED. Hand-maintaining both directions is how fxsave came to list fxUSD as BOTH its upstream and its downstream — one edge recorded twice, in opposite directions. Add the edge to the UPSTREAM array of the dependent asset and re-run build.

dependencies.is_partition_basis: Qualitative dependency inventory; no allocation percentages are summed.
